label: Account
definition: Platform-local managed identity representation associated with an IdentitySubject; not the subject itself.

label: UserProfile
definition: Mutable information record containing account- or subject-related attributes in an IAM system.

label: IdentitySource
definition: Role played by a system or service from which identity information is obtained.

label: AuthoritativeIdentitySource
definition: IdentitySource role that is authoritative for specified identity information or account data.

label: IdentityStore
definition: Information service/repository that persists accounts profiles groups or identity data.

label: AdministrativeDomain
definition: Operational administration boundary such as tenant realm environment or population.

label: Application
definition: Software entity that may play relying-party client resource-server or principal roles.

label: ApplicationRegistration
definition: Configuration information object describing an application/client registration in an identity domain.

label: Federation
definition: Inter-organizational/system identity relationship enabling authentication or identity information exchange across domains.

label: FederationConnection
definition: Configured relationship implementing federation between identity systems/providers and relying applications.

label: IdentityBroker
definition: Intermediary role that mediates identity/authentication flows between external identity sources/providers and relying systems.

label: Provisioning
definition: Process/event that creates updates synchronizes disables or removes platform-local account/profile representations.

label: ProvisioningConnection
definition: Configured source-target relationship through which identity data is provisioned.

label: AttributeMapping
definition: Mapping artifact defining source-to-target identity attribute/claim transformation and provenance.

label: Session
definition: Temporally bounded security interaction context established after authentication and maintained independently from AuthenticationResult.

label: PermissionBundle
definition: Normative bundle of permissions corresponding to IAM roles permission sets or similar operational constructs.

label: AccessPolicy
definition: Normative policy artifact governing access grants or authorization decisions.

label: AccessCondition
definition: Predicate/condition artifact used in access policies or authorization evaluation.

label: AccessGroup
definition: Operational grouping used for assignment provisioning or access management; not a social-identity group.

label: GroupMembership
definition: Membership relation between an account/principal and an operational access group.

label: Issuer
definition: Contextual role played by a party that issues a Credential.

label: Holder
definition: Contextual role played by an entity that possesses controls or presents a credential; not necessarily its subject.

label: CredentialPresentationVerifier
definition: Verifier role that evaluates a credential presentation and associated evidence/proof.

label: Wallet
definition: Role played by software that stores manages or presents credentials on behalf of a holder.

label: HolderService
definition: Service-provider role that stores manages or enables reusable identity/credential holdings for a holder.

label: CredentialPresentation
definition: Event in which a holder or wallet presents credential-derived information/evidence to a verifier.

label: PresentationRequest
definition: Information object expressing requested credential claims constraints or presentation requirements.

label: Controller
definition: Role played by an entity authorized to control an identifier or verification material.

label: VerificationMethod
definition: Information/cryptographic artifact used to verify signatures proofs or control relationships.

label: VerifiableDataRegistry
definition: Information service providing status schema identifier or trusted-entity information for credential ecosystems.

label: SelectiveDisclosure
definition: Capability/mode of a presentation enabling disclosure of a subset or derived subset of credential information.

label: VerifiablePresentation
definition: Presentation information artifact carrying selected credential-derived claims and proofs.

label: Workload
definition: Running compute entity such as a process container job or deployed workload that can play IdentitySubject and Principal roles.

label: RuntimeInstance
definition: Concrete execution instance of software or a workload at runtime.

label: ServiceAccount
definition: Non-human managed account representation used by software or automation.

label: ServicePrincipal
definition: Tenant/domain-local security-principal role representing an application or service for authorization.

label: ManagedIdentity
definition: Managed workload-identity pattern in which credential lifecycle is controlled by the platform.

label: Device
definition: Physical or virtual device capable of independently playing identity subject principal and/or authenticator roles.

label: DeviceIdentityRecord
definition: Directory or registry representation of a device distinct from the device and its credentials.

label: NodeAttestation
definition: Attestation event establishing properties/identity of a node or host used as evidence for workload identity.

label: WorkloadAttestation
definition: Attestation event establishing which runtime workload is requesting an identity or credential.

label: TrustDomain
definition: Identity namespace/security boundary backed by an issuing authority and trust material.
core_alignment: Distinct from IdentityContext and P04 TrustFramework

label: TrustBundle
definition: Cryptographic trust artifact containing authoritative verification material for a trust domain.

label: SVID
definition: SPIFFE verifiable identity document carrying a SPIFFE identifier and cryptographic proof material.

label: TemporaryCredential
definition: Short-lived credential issued for a session federated principal workload or agent.

label: TokenExchange
definition: Event transforming or exchanging external proof/credential for a local temporary credential or security context.

label: SoftwareAgent
definition: Goal-directed software entity capable of acting autonomously or on delegated authority.

label: AIAgent
definition: SoftwareAgent specialization whose behavior is driven substantially by AI models/planning mechanisms.

label: AgentIdentity
definition: Managed digital identity representation specifically associated with a SoftwareAgent.

label: AgentSponsor
definition: Accountability/governance role played by a person or organization responsible for an agent identity lifecycle.

label: TrustFramework
definition: Governed normative framework defining rules obligations requirements and trust conditions for ecosystem participation/services.

label: GovernanceFramework
definition: Normative governance framework defining institutional roles conformance processes and operating rules.

label: TrustRegistry
definition: Governed information service registering participants providers credentials or trust status.

label: TrustedList
definition: Governed information artifact enumerating trusted/certified services or entities and their statuses.

label: TrustAnchor
definition: Authoritative/cryptographic root role used as a terminus for a trust chain.

label: TrustChain
definition: Structured path of trust statements certificates or entity statements terminating at a trust anchor.

label: GovernanceAuthority
definition: Institutional role responsible for defining or enforcing framework rules.

label: Registrar
definition: Institutional role responsible for registering ecosystem participants/services.

label: Regulator
definition: Institutional oversight role responsible for regulatory supervision or enforcement.

label: ConformityAssessmentBody
definition: Independent role performing conformity assessment against a framework/profile.

label: Certification
definition: Governance event/process establishing certified status against defined requirements.

label: Accreditation
definition: Governance event/process establishing authority/competence status of a conformity-assessment actor.

label: EcosystemParticipation
definition: Governed relationship connecting a participant to a trust/governance ecosystem with status and scope.

label: ParticipantStatus
definition: Dependent status of an ecosystem participation such as approved suspended revoked or expired.

label: LegalIdentity
definition: Legally recognized identity construct used as a government/legal basis for digital identity processes; profile-scoped and human/legal centric.

label: PersonIdentificationData
definition: Governed identity data set about a person used in legal/government identification contexts.

label: GovernmentAttestation
definition: Government or regulated attestation carrying verified attributes/status about a subject.

label: IdentityServiceProvider
definition: Broad service-provider role supplying proofing authentication attribute or identity-management services in governed ecosystems.
